tour.greeting: Hi, I am your study buddy. Hand me your courseware and notes and I will turn them into a study plan. Stuck on something? Dig through the knowledge base, or just ask me. Study Space helps you focus, I am in the bottom right, and you can switch models in Settings. All six entries are here — pick one and try it. One more thing: those floating panels can be dragged to the screen edge to collapse and free up space.
